title: 12 Best Walk the weathered wooden walkways of Penang
description: Explore Penang's iconic heritage streets and wooden jetties. Discover the best hawker stalls, hidden cafes, and historic restaurants along your walking journey in George Town.

places.name: Hameediyah Restaurant
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Nasi Kandar with their signature Ayam Goreng (fried chicken) and various curries (beef, mutton, fish head). Don't miss the Murtabak.

places.name: Penang Road Famous Teochew Chendul
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The original Teochew Chendul. You can also try their Ice Kacang.

places.name: Toh Soon Cafe
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Roti Bakar Arang (charcoal-toasted bread with kaya and butter) and a cup of Kopi-O (black coffee).

places.name: Tek Sen Restaurant
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Double Roasted Pork with Chili Padi, French Beans with Minced Pork, and the Assam Prawns.

places.name: ChinaHouse
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Any of their famous cakes (e.g., Tiramisu, Carrot Cake), and a strong coffee or a refreshing cocktail.

places.name: Restoran Kimberley Street Koay Teow Th'ng
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Koay Teow Th'ng with duck meat or specify 'all fishball' for a lighter option.

places.name: Auntie Gaik Lean's Old School Eatery
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Assam Pedas Fish, Curry Kapitan, and the Otak-Otak. Don't forget the Kerabu Prawns.

places.name: Sri Ananda Bahwan
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Banana Leaf Rice with various vegetable curries, supplemented with their Chicken 65 or Mutton Varuval.

places.name: The Daily Dose Cafe
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their specialty coffee and a hearty brunch item like Eggs Benedict or a croissant sandwich.

places.name: My Nyonya Favourites
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Laksa Lemak, Nasi Ulam, and a selection of Nyonya kuih.

places.name: Gat Lebuh Chulia Hawker Centre
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Try the Hokkien Mee, Char Koay Teow, Satay, and Apom Balik from different stalls.

places.name: Indigo Restaurant at The Blue Mansion
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their tasting menu or signature dishes like the Pan-Seared Barramundi or Australian Lamb Rack, paired with a curated wine list.
